Overview

St. Petersburg is a city in FL with a population of 258,308. Sunshine City with waterfront parks, art museums, and no state income tax on the Gulf. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
